features.name: Blessed Help
features.description: You know the spare the dying cantrip. At 3rd level, you can cast bless once with this trait and regain use on a long rest. Charisma is your spellcasting ability.

features.name: Clan Leader
features.description: You have proficiency in the Persuasion skill.

features.name: Restful Spores
features.description: If you or any friendly creatures within 30 feet of you regain hit points at the end of a short rest by spending Hit Dice, each of those creatures regains additional hit points equal to your proficiency bonus. Once a creature benefits, it can't again until it finishes a long rest.
